answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities through cryptographic stake burning anchored to physical verifiers, such as proof-of-work on basalt hash puzzles. Registration requires burning tokens where cost scales superlinearly: minting n counterfeit nodes demands an exponential burn of n² collateral, drowning fraudulent swarms in economic friction like a river surging over a cedar barrier to make coordinated subversion prohibitively expensive.
